review.gallery: 8 project renders from Nshama’s live project gallery. The April 25, 2026 DLD album for project 3749 shows the fenced plot area and surrounding construction. The selected frame is a street context view. Background structures are not attributed to Olbia. Inspection index https://dubaihandover.com/projects/3749-olbia.
review.location: The project is marked on brochure physical page 8. The master-plan panel is shown separately from the community figures below it. The project-specific DLD point from Dubai Handover agrees with that part of the community. Nearby times are from physical page 6 and apply to Town Square.
review.floorPlans: All six sheets from the Nshama floor-plan PDF linked on the project page. Earlier revisions list differing figures for some families, so the current linked document controls these labels. All selected printed built-up totals were visually checked. Minor rounding differences in displayed suite and balcony components are retained through the published total.

unavailable: Confirmed visitor entrance, completed-building photography and a complete duplex drawing set.
